title: Cheap garbage
text: Cheap garbage. I read through the reviews. I decided to take a chance. Yeah, don't buy these. Washed them before use following directions on label. Put them on the bed. They were thin, and cheap. You get what you pay for. The worst part though is that there is no elasticity in the fitted sheet. Maybe I got a defective set, or is there just not supposed to be any elastic in it? It won’t stay on the bed. Which is honestly, the only responsibility a sheet has. I ordered it in purple. So please comment if you had a similar experience because maybe there was a bad batch that didn’t get the elastic sewn in? Lol.
